authority: #K2-367 (owner's fundamental challenge accepted: NO appeal to authority - the model and the correctness source are declared here; any algorithm deviating from this model is rejected)

state_space.O_l: on layer l, the FORBIDDEN DOMAIN: hole keepouts, foreign-net copper plus the clearance band delta, and illegal via sites; a closed planar set per layer
state_space.N: the net set; each net n has a terminal set P(n) (its pads) - CONNECTIVITY IS TOPOLOGICAL (a hypergraph edge) and is NOT changed by moving parts; only the terminal coordinates change
state_space.T: the existing copper geometry (segments/vias) with net attribution

steps.name: placement feasibility
steps.predicate: the new pad positions enter no forbidden domain, no other part's courtyard, and stay inside the board edge

steps.name: damage set D(C,Delta) subset of T
steps.predicate: segments whose endpoint references a moved pad UNION segments intersecting the new footprint

steps.name: re-implementation problem (CORE)
steps.statement: after removing D, for every damaged net n find R'(n) inside the free space F_l = l minus (O_l UNION the other nets' implementations UNION the clearance halo), connecting P(n) with multi-terminal paths on the OCTILINEAR GRID, vias allowed only at legal via sites
steps.implemented: heuristic search: eda_eng route.maze_route (Lee/A* on the octilinear grid over F_l; layer change = via at legal sites) - NO completeness guarantee

algorithm_derivation.question: does a re-implementation EXIST?
algorithm_derivation.decidability: NP-hard in general - no tool has a general fast exact solution
algorithm_derivation.algorithm: heuristic: octilinear-grid A*/Lee with layer choice and rip-up retry; NO completeness guarantee

correctness_source.principle: commercial EDA has no general guaranteed algorithm either; their correctness also comes from CHECKERS (DRC/LVS), not from the router. Appeal to authority is rejected.
sources: (1) a SOUND JUDGE: M4 - any candidate implementation can be decided right/wrong
(2) THE EXAMS: bounded instances with known reference answers, so the heuristic's completeness is TESTABLE
(3) SEMANTIC DISCIPLINE: a search result of 'no path found' MUST be read as NOT FOUND, never as IMPOSSIBLE; an impossibility claim requires an infeasibility certificate on a bounded instance
correctness_source.enforced_in_code: route.maze_route returns status BLOCKED with semantics=NOT_FOUND (never 'impossible'); the wording is locked by a unit test (test_maze_semantics_is_NOT_FOUND_never_IMPOSSIBLE)

eda_eng relocate.step_1: shadow project root + gen_v5 (placement only; the real tree is never touched)
eda_eng relocate.step_4: maze_route (heuristic search per this model; built in R966)

implementation_map.rule: any algorithm that deviates from this model is rejected; this file is the reference
